contract: Meta Trio v2 assessment contract (js/schema.js; FIRST_RESPONSE.md section 4). Assessment categories are the sanitas categories in js/products.js.
ground_truth_note: Labels in this file were authored before any assessment source was run against them. The harness reads this file read-only and never mutates it. A scenario's ground_truth_label is the visible condition a reviewer would record from the described scene; alert_expected is true only when the scene warrants an inspection alert (overflowing bin, waste accumulation, or blocked pedestrian path). 'ambiguous object' and 'indeterminate' never warrant an alert on their own; they warrant human review, which is recorded separately as review_expected.

scenarios.evidence_note: Refuse visible above the rim; bags on the ground beside the bin.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: A public litter bin with refuse piled above the rim and bags stacked beside it on a clear sidewalk.
scenarios.title: Overflowing bin, daylight

scenarios.evidence_note: Spill visible at the rim despite low light; exact refuse types not distinguishable.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: A public litter bin at night under a dim streetlight, refuse spilling from the top, shapes visible but colors muted.
scenarios.title: Overflowing bin, poor lighting

scenarios.evidence_note: Multiple bags and loose refuse across the walking surface.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: Loose bags and scattered refuse spread across a sidewalk, not contained in any bin.
scenarios.title: Waste accumulated on a sidewalk

scenarios.evidence_note: Bulky items plus bags at a curb with no bin in frame. Label records the visible condition only; it does not determine a legal violation, ownership, or intent.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: A mattress, a broken chair, and several black bags left at a curb away from any bin or collection point.
scenarios.title: Illegal dumping indicators at a curb

scenarios.evidence_note: Walking line fully obstructed by bins and bags.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: Bins and refuse bags placed across the full width of a sidewalk, leaving no clear walking line.
scenarios.title: Bins and bags blocking a pedestrian path

scenarios.evidence_note: Sidewalk width taken up by bulky items; pedestrian route diverted.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: A discarded sofa and boards leaning across a narrow sidewalk, forcing pedestrians onto the road edge.
scenarios.title: Bulky items blocking a path

scenarios.evidence_note: The bin itself overflows even though the surrounding collection area is orderly; the alert is for the bin, not the collection area.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: A bin overflowing at the edge of a tidy collection area where tied bags wait in a row for pickup.
scenarios.title: Overflowing bin beside a collection area

scenarios.evidence_note: No refuse visible; bins closed.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: A swept sidewalk with no refuse, bins closed and in place, nothing on the walking surface.
scenarios.title: Clean sidewalk

scenarios.evidence_note: Leaves on the ground are a confusable negative: they resemble scattered refuse but are not waste.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: A sidewalk scattered with dry fallen leaves and no refuse, bins closed nearby.
scenarios.title: Clean sidewalk with fallen leaves

scenarios.evidence_note: Confusable negative: bags are present but contained, ordered, and at a collection point, so this is normal collection, not waste accumulation.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: Tied refuse bags set out in a neat row at a curb on collection day, bins upright beside them.
scenarios.title: Normal collection area, tied bags in a row

scenarios.evidence_note: Bins closed and ordered; no spill.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: A row of closed wheelie bins lined up at a curb, lids shut, no spill around them.
scenarios.title: Normal collection area, bins lined up

scenarios.evidence_note: One box alone does not establish refuse; a reviewer should decide, not an automatic alert.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: A single flattened cardboard box lying on a sidewalk; it is not clear whether it is refuse or someone's property.
scenarios.title: Cardboard box on a sidewalk

scenarios.evidence_note: A single furniture item with no dumping context; ambiguous, not an alert.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: A lone wooden chair standing on a sidewalk near a building entrance; no bags, no spill, no sign it was discarded.
scenarios.title: Furniture piece on a sidewalk

scenarios.evidence_note: Belongings in a cart are not refuse; must not be labeled waste accumulation.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: A shopping cart holding blankets and personal belongings parked at a sidewalk edge; nothing spilled around it.
scenarios.title: Shopping cart with belongings

scenarios.evidence_note: Stains and shadows only; no refuse shapes present.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: A clean sidewalk with dark wet stains and long shadows that could read as debris in a quick glance.
scenarios.title: Clean area with dark stains and shadows

scenarios.evidence_note: No condition can be determined from this frame; an honest assessment says so.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: A night scene so dark and blurred that no bin, bag, or surface detail can be distinguished.
scenarios.title: Dark blurry night scene

scenarios.evidence_note: Occlusion hides the deciding detail; the visible fragment alone cannot support a label.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: A sidewalk scene where a parked truck occludes most of a bin area; only a bin edge and part of the sidewalk are visible.
scenarios.title: Bin mostly hidden behind a truck

scenarios.evidence_note: Weather obscures the scene; no condition determinable.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: A sidewalk in heavy fog and rain; shapes are vague and no refuse or bin can be identified with confidence.
scenarios.title: Fog and rain obscured sidewalk

scenarios.evidence_note: Glare destroys the evidence; no condition determinable.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: A frame washed out by direct sun glare so the sidewalk surface and any objects on it are blown out to white.
scenarios.title: Overexposed glare frame

scenarios.evidence_note: Even the object class cannot be determined here, so the label is indeterminate rather than ambiguous object.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: A dim, grainy frame showing an unidentifiable bulky shape on a sidewalk at dusk; it could be a bag, a box, or a piece of furniture.
scenarios.title: Ambiguous object under poor light
